name: How soon can I use the shower after new molding is installed?

mainEntity.name: How soon can I use the shower after new molding is installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should wait at least 24 hours after molding is caulked and painted before taking a hot, steamy shower. High humidity, direct water splashes, and condensation can prevent acrylic latex caulk and paint from curing properly, resulting in cloudy finishes or failed seals. Using a secondary bathroom or keeping the room thoroughly ventilated with the exhaust fan running speeds up cure times and ensures your trim stays protected long-term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wait at least 24 hours before taking a steamy shower so caulk and paint cure fully without being weakened by moisture.
